verdict.rationale: Pylon gives scoping control over which issues the AI agent touches: you assign the agent to the issues you want it on, described as 'full control' (pylon-docs-18, pylon-docs-40). Natural-language runbooks and triggers could plausibly steer agents away from specific scenarios (pylon-docs-15, pylon-docs-73, pylon-docs-30), and rubrics can audit compliance after the fact (pylon-docs-74). However, none of this documents marking topics like legal threats, cancellations or security as human-only with a hard escalation. Missing for 10: an explicit topic-based human-only or exclusion setting, guaranteed handoff when a restricted topic is detected mid-conversation, documented enforcement that the agent never replies on those topics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
